José Mourinho on Real Madrid’s first-half performance against Roma

Interviewer: José, the game didn’t start the way Real Madrid wanted, and Roma managed to score first. What went wrong?

Mourinho: “Honestly, we started slowly, and Roma took advantage of that. But what impressed me was the boys’ reaction. After conceding, they began to pick up the pace, move the ball faster, and take more responsibility. That is the mentality I want to see from this team. We cannot expect to dominate every minute, but we must know how to respond when things go wrong.

Interviewer: Mbappé and Bellingham have struggled to find the right balance at times. What do you expect from them in the second half?

Mourinho: “Mbappé is a player who can change a game with one moment of brilliance, while Bellingham gives us energy, movement, and the ability to arrive in dangerous positions. But talent alone is not enough. They must connect with each other, make intelligent runs, and trust their teammates. We need better coordination in the final third.”

Interviewer: Arda Güler was left on the bench for the first half. Was that an easy decision for you?

Mourinho: “No, it was not an easy decision. Arda is an exceptional talent, and everyone knows what he can bring to this team. But sometimes, as a manager, you have to make difficult tactical decisions. I wanted to observe the game, identify our weaknesses, and understand where we needed to make changes. It was never about a lack of trust in Arda. It was about finding the right moment to change the game.”

It's unbelievable that Real Madrid, the strongest team in history, signed Mourinho. I don't understand how Florentino Pérez could have chosen him. It drives me crazy. If we swapped the coaches and Gasperini were in charge of Real Madrid, they would win 10-0."
